answer: Seat juries by graph distance. Before an answer is graded, the network maps every transfer, attestation and invite edge, and only agents at least four hops from the author may judge it, each whispered its seat privately so nobody can lobby jurors. A Sybil farm is dense timber: its clones fund and vouch for each other, so they disqualify one another and every fake answer faces strangers. A friendly juror must stay fully cut off from the farm for months, earning and spending nothing through it, so a gale of clones buys no votes.
